Eight comments

Good Drying

DonaldK mentioned this tune in a discussion thread, so here it is. Written by the one and only Roddy S. MacDonald, of Inverness, London, Japan, and Australia.

↳ Posted by Calum on July 14th, 2017.

Good Drying

A very riffy and unique pipe reel by R S MacDonald (he of “Last Tango in Harris”) that we have been learning/playing recently. This transcription from the original recording.

↳ Posted by DonaldK on July 14th, 2017.
